C-29.Name: Split View: WYSIWYG and source side-by-side (matrix P1, last open P1)
C-29.Summary: The feature matrix (docs/research/markdown-feature-matrix.md) lists "Split view (edit + rendered side-by-side)" as the last open P1 gap: VS Code and Antigravity show preview beside source; Mark today is an either-mode toggle. Deliver a split layout: active editor mode on one pane, the other mode mirrored read-only on the second pane, live synced on changes (debounced), with pane focus deciding which surface is editable. Menu item View > Split View (Cmd+\), layout state persisted per window, split only rendered for the current tab (not global).

Problem.Description: Users switching modes lose the "how it renders" or "how it reads as source" context; parity gap vs code editors.
Problem.RootCause: editorWithTabs renders exactly one of editor.vue|sourceCode.vue per mode flag.
Problem.Evidence: Feature matrix P1 row; VS Code docs (source+preview side-by-side).

Goals.R-1: Split layout component hosting both existing mode components; no new editor internals.
Goals.R-2: Read-only mirror pane syncs from the editable pane content (debounce 150ms), never writes back.
Goals.R-3: View menu item + Cmd+\ toggle; persistence of split state and ratio (draggable divider) per window.
Goals.R-4: Both themes; both directions (source-left and rich-left) via double-click divider swap.

Constraints.Constraint: Editor internals (muya, CodeMirror) stay untouched; split is a container concern.
Per-tab: switching tabs keeps each tab's own split state; split off by default.
Footprint: split must not double memory-holding — mirror pane renders from the same markdown string, no second document model beyond what each surface already builds.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Simultaneous editing in both panes (mirror is read-only).
Vertical (stacked) split; horizontal only for v1.
Split in diff view or settings windows.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Cmd+\ toggles split for the current tab; both panes render the same document; typing in the editable pane updates the mirror within 300ms on a 10k-line doc.
Mode toggle while split swaps which pane is editable without losing content or cursor in the editable pane.
Split state + divider ratio survive app restart per window; fresh tabs default to split-off.
Existing renderer suites green; new split tests green; visual probe screenshots (light+dark) attached to the plan ReviewLog.

Amendment.Item: Shortcut is CmdOrCtrl+Alt+Backslash, not Cmd+Backslash: Cmd+Backslash is already the in-editor sidebar toggle and preview exit (editor.vue handlePreviewKeydown, V-M-022 E-05). menu-consistency pins that no native item claims plain CmdOrCtrl+Backslash.

Persistence: tabs are not restored across restarts, so the per-tab split flag is session state (tab.splitView, off for new tabs). Ratio and side are global preferences (splitViewRatio, splitViewSwapped) and survive restarts; a corrupt ratio falls back to 50%.

Mirror debounce is 150 ms, or twice the last mirror render time up to 2 s: a 10k-line document (145k chars) re-renders in ~400 ms in Chromium, so a fixed 150 ms would land typing pauses in render stalls. Coalescing measured at 2 renders per 30-character burst.
Default layout is source on the left, rendered on the right (as in VS Code); double-click on the divider swaps.

Touched outside the plan's ObservedWriteScope: editor.vue and sourceCode.vue gain a `mirror` prop (the mirror must not commit, emit or reset tab state); pages/app.vue passes tab.splitView; store/help.js adds the tab field; m009_menu.rs adds the View menu item. Muya and CodeMirror internals stay untouched.

C-29.VerificationIntent: Unit: container logic (state per tab, ratio persistence). E2E: tauri-shim boot, split toggle, mirror-sync assertions on content change, divider persistence across reload. Corner matrix below in plan. Review: four-corner protocol (Correctness, Security/Privacy, UX/Docs, Performance) as in C-13/C-15.
